title: Yearbook and Locker
author: X. M. Voss
blurb: Hazel Kavanagh, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
